name: ops-control
description: Ops Control for Claude Code, with the Sidequest work board and prismantis rendering.

plugins.name: ops-control
plugins.description: A cockpit pane for plan, context, guardrails, agents, diff, music and settings; a work bar over the prompt with milestones and context; name packs and pets; keyboard navigation (Alt+1-7, arrows).

plugins.name: sidequest
plugins.description: Eigenwise's local work board and orchestration loop, with the arcade dashboard restyle, a Claude sessions page and comment edit/delete.

plugins.name: prismantis
plugins.description: Nahum Litvin's colorful, themeable rendering for Claude Code replies: tables, headings, code, numbers, paths and links.
